name: riseSpeed
meaning: vertical speed per second (Emitter_UpdateRiseToCap 0x52cd1a mov edx,[ecx]; imul g_dt); negative = up

name: life
meaning: maximum particle life in ticks (0x52cc9b idiv [ecx+4])

name: spawnInterval
meaning: passed to the spawner (0x52ccf8 mov eax,[edx+8])

name: size
meaning: particle size (0x52cd04 mov dx,[ecx+0xc]); Wolf_UpdateTrailFx randomises it 10..20 (0x48e492)

name: cap
meaning: height above which (smaller vertical) particles die; Wolf_UpdateTrailFx sets it to the water top (0x48e480)

name: sheetIndex
meaning: sprite sheet copied to emitter+0x20 (0x52ccc6 mov dl,[ecx+0x10])
